A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 34-page versions of SurvDiff. The main sections, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–J can be matched; v3 additionally contains Appendices K–L.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic-data and downstream survival experiments on AIDS, GBSG2, and METABRIC, including repeated-run results, ablations, and differential-privacy experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and reports revised covariate and survival visualizations.

M1.justification: Table 4 revises the stated transformer configuration from 5 hidden layers to 3 encoder and 3 decoder layers. This is a limited model-specification revision; the diffusion processes, survival head, losses, weighting, and sampling remain unchanged. Whether this corrects documentation or reflects a changed implementation is unspecified.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same three datasets and retain the reduced-sample and differential-privacy settings. Appendix L discusses left truncation, interval censoring, and multiple endpoints only as future extensions, without evaluating them.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: NFlow, TVAE, CTGAN, TabDiff, SurvivalGAN, and Ashhad in the main comparisons, TabDiff in the reduced-sample study, and DP-GAN in the privacy experiment. The newly cited Liu and Wang work is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Covariate diagnostics switch from t-SNE to UMAP, and Figures 3, 5, and 6 replace JS-distance annotations with UMAP Coverage scores. Table 4 also revises the reported transformer depth. Other stated evaluation settings are retained; the PDFs do not establish that the benchmark experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The covariate-geometry diagnostics are revised using UMAP, and Figures 10–12 contain changed Kaplan–Meier trajectories. These revise existing fidelity analyses. The weighting ablation, decay-parameter sensitivity, reduced-sample study, and training-loss analysis remain.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same ten-run/seed descriptions, mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, and shaded survival plots. v3 discusses variability more explicitly but introduces no new uncertainty-estimation procedure or statistical test.

E6.justification: Figures 3, 5, and 6 replace plotted JS scores with UMAP Coverage results; for example, SurvDiff's GBSG2 annotation changes from JS 0.120 to coverage 0.786, which are not directly comparable metrics. Kaplan–Meier trajectories also change: in Figure 12, SurvDiff's late METABRIC curve switches from below to above the real curve. Numerical results in Tables 2–3 and 7–14 are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, diffusion and survival objectives, calibration formula, and privacy equations are retained. Appendix K provides conceptual positioning rather than a new ELBO derivation or proof. The repaired closing parenthesis in the ETD equation does not change its mathematics.

C1.justification: The introduction qualifies the missing prior model as end-to-end and changes the loss's role from ensuring event-time and censoring fidelity to encouraging faithful synthetic data. These are limited qualifications; the central novelty claim, contribution list, and conclusion remain substantially unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 6 newly acknowledges stronger METABRIC Wasserstein results from TVAE and TabDiff, stronger downstream scores from TabDiff, and SurvDiff's variability. Appendix K interprets the Cox term as an observed-data regularizer rather than a censoring-process model. Appendix L explicitly explains limitations concerning censoring types and multiple endpoints.

D1.justification: Table 4 changes the documented transformer depth and specifies its encoder/decoder split. Hardware, training budgets, preprocessing, and code/data access instructions are otherwise retained. The new UMAP Coverage scores lack a corresponding definition or detailed implementation settings.

R1.justification: v3 adds Liu and Wang's Censor Dependent Variational Inference and Appendix K distinguishes it from SurvDiff's observed-tuple generation. Section 4 more explicitly attributes the diffusion components to established tabular modeling. Consolidating Ashhad's preprint/publication citations and updating TabDiff's year are bibliographic changes.

P1.justification: The main section sequence is preserved. Changes comprise localized grammatical edits, expanded results discussion, revised method positioning, an impact statement, and new Appendices K–L. Author/header text and citation formatting also change, without extensive narrative reorganization.

P2.justification: The main text and references change from a single-column preprint layout to a two-column conference layout, substantially resizing and repositioning figures and tables. Six covariate displays are replaced with UMAP plots, including revised axes and annotations; the combined Kaplan–Meier figures are also redrawn.

improvement.justification: v3 better aligns its discussion with the unchanged tables by acknowledging METABRIC disadvantages and variability. Appendices K–L clarify the survival regularizer's interpretation and applicability limits. These improve scientific clarity, although undefined UMAP Coverage scores and the unexplained transformer-depth revision limit reproducibility. The net gain is modest.
